snippet.title: PlayStation - Uki Uki Tsuri Tengoku - Ningyo Densetsu no Nazo (1997) - Intro
snippet.description:
DESCRIPTION
Uki Uki Tsuri Tengoku: Ningyo Densetsu no Nazo is a Sports game, published by Tenchiku Records, which was released in Japan in 1997.
